name: Tautulli
description: Opt-in auto-update extracts an unsigned, unhashed GitHub tarball directly over the running installation.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Tautulli extracts the downloaded GitHub tarball over the program directory without a payload signature/hash.
limitations: Newly retrieved source snapshot at the recorded checkout; this is not historical release re-verification. Released artifacts and external framework enforcement remain unverified.

original_evidence.text: | Tautulli | https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli | c7153de / 2026-06-16 | Y | Y (`PLEXPY_AUTO_UPDATE` config: scheduler calls `check_github()` then `plexpy.shutdown(restart=True, update=True)` fully unattended for git/source installs) | Y (git install: `git pull --ff-only`; source install: downloads GitHub tarball over HTTPS and `tarfile.extractall()`s it directly over the live program directory, then restarts into the new code) | https, `requests` with `verify=bool(CONFIG.VERIFY_SSL_CERT)` — **default is enabled (1)** but is a user-toggleable config option that silently disables cert validation network-wide (including the update-tarball fetch) if turned off | N | none — no hash or signature check anywhere in `update()` before the tarball is extracted and files overwritten | N/A | plexpy/versioncheck.py:284-287 (auto-update trigger from scheduler), :318-347 (`request.request_content(tar_download_url)` → `tarfile.extractall` → `os.renames` over PROG_DIR, no checksum/signature step); plexpy/request.py:55-56,147-148 (`verify=bool(CONFIG.VERIFY_SSL_CERT)`); plexpy/config.py:197 (default `VERIFY_SSL_CERT=1`) |

fields.label: auto
fields.value: Y (`PLEXPY_AUTO_UPDATE` config: scheduler calls `check_github()` then `plexpy.shutdown(restart=True, update=True)` fully unattended for git/source installs)

fields.label: downloads_and_executes
fields.value: Y (git install: `git pull --ff-only`; source install: downloads GitHub tarball over HTTPS and `tarfile.extractall()`s it directly over the live program directory, then restarts into the new code)

fields.label: transport
fields.value: https, `requests` with `verify=bool(CONFIG.VERIFY_SSL_CERT)` — **default is enabled (1)** but is a user-toggleable config option that silently disables cert validation network-wide (including the update-tarball fetch) if turned off

fields.label: payload_verification
fields.value: none — no hash or signature check anywhere in `update()` before the tarball is extracted and files overwritten
